text.content:
Chapter 7 · The Ward File. Installment 2: revision of the chain of copies and Part 2.

This section replaces what installment 1 and Thornquist's profile (@UUID[JournalEntry.dj4gIszHHTN1QRKk]{PNJ-13}) say about the origin of the copies. Where they contradict, this text wins.

@UUID[JournalEntry.uDNdrVnGBbAh18Tt]{Halloway} wanted the whole File, and all to himself. But the crew @UUID[JournalEntry.y8Ao3xEHH3W11EJe]{Gale} hired (@UUID[Actor.9rv5Jdb3y6bZZ1fj]{MEN-01}) wasn't as loyal as the check. One of the thieves, @UUID[Actor.9rv5Jdb3y6bZZ1fj]{Lonnie Barras}, knew that a drive someone pays that much for is worth more in pieces. During the car ride, while his partner was at the wheel, he plugged the drive into a laptop and copied three blocks of folders onto three thumb drives. Then he handed the original drive to @UUID[Actor.BzNGxOAK3F6Uo56T]{Dawson}, Gale's ghoul head of security (MEN-04), as if nothing had happened.

The next night, Lonnie sold two of the thumb drives to @UUID[Actor.mto8LnnsUQgFr1DI]{Sal Medeiros} (MEN-13), a SoDo fence who buys and sells “strange things” to clients who only come out at night. He kept the third as insurance. Sal, in turn, offered the two drives to @UUID[JournalEntry.dj4gIszHHTN1QRKk]{Thornquist}, who bought them, made a copy of each for his own vault (it's his habit: he duplicates everything he sells), and had @UUID[JournalEntry.BRQMU0Tf8VSNaZ5o]{Jun Takeda} deliver them to two buyers.

On Night 2, Gale found in the drive's logs that someone had opened the folders at 3:40 a.m., in the middle of the ride, and told Halloway. Halloway gave @UUID[JournalEntry.OmK2qlPVNl758u6h]{Krell} a list: recover or destroy every copy, and every Kindred who has touched them. So the hunt begins.

Copy Contents Route Where it is at the start of Part 2
Original The whole File, 2016–2026 Thieves → Dawson → Gale Gale Sentinel data center (@UUID[JournalEntry.zSkwEUUtkNGhfXun]{LUG-07}). Moves to Halloway's vault (@UUID[JournalEntry.L6Fl1S0tjkWno2we]{LUG-06}) on Night 6.
USB 1 Folders 2014–2018 (includes the Larchmont) Lonnie → Sal → Thornquist → Jun → Pike In the coterie's hands if they recovered it in @UUID[JournalEntry.5hwXPdn0tUJ3NaKZ.JournalEntryPage.DtetdHiBnOLQaM6Y]{A1-E02 · Ash on Pier 46}; if not, in the police chain of custody and copied by FIRSTLIGHT.
USB 2 Folders 2019–2022 Lonnie → Sal → Thornquist → Jun In Jun's pocket, or in the coterie's hands (@UUID[JournalEntry.5hwXPdn0tUJ3NaKZ.JournalEntryPage.lM1EiE1FoXMkf3Uo]{A1-E04 · Everything Sells Below}).
USB 3 Folders 2023–2026 (the most recent; includes the folders on the most active PCs and episode 112) Lonnie With Lonnie, hiding out in a motel on Aurora Avenue (@UUID[JournalEntry.FttkHsYSSaCpIugu.JournalEntryPage.5Vgl8slqjXlVRbie]{A2-E06 · The One Who Kept One}).
Thornquist's duplicates Copies of USB 1 and 2 Thornquist In a safe in the Sealed Underground. Krell doesn't know they exist.

Note: Helen started documenting in 2014. I'm correcting the reference to “ten years” accordingly: the archive covers twelve years, though she still says “ten” because it's what she's been repeating for a long time.

• @UUID[JournalEntry.5hwXPdn0tUJ3NaKZ.JournalEntryPage.lM1EiE1FoXMkf3Uo]{A1-E04 · Everything Sells Below}, Thornquist's dialogue guide: to “Where did you get them?” he now answers: “From a SoDo fence who buys what nobody else wants to touch. He got it from a mortal who kept something that wasn't his. Knowing the fence's name is worth a minor favor. The mortal's name, I don't know, and that bothers me.” (, partially.)
  • A1-E04, Storyteller Notes: if the coterie doesn't act, the Night 5 auction sells Thornquist's duplicates. Krell doesn't go after them because he doesn't know they exist. all the same, because one of the buyers is @UUID[JournalEntry.D611Mcr17F6HHEUw]{Hale}.
  • Halloway's Clock, updated:
Night Event if nobody intervenes
2 Krell destroys @UUID[Actor.IdLdXpR0cpQaUeFd]{Pike} at Pier 46 (@UUID[JournalEntry.5hwXPdn0tUJ3NaKZ.JournalEntryPage.DtetdHiBnOLQaM6Y]{A1-E02 · Ash on Pier 46}). Gale discovers the drive was copied. ARCHER's first drop.
3 Elysium night (@UUID[JournalEntry.FttkHsYSSaCpIugu.JournalEntryPage.uL8F2YNogcToiFc6]{A2-E01 · Elysium Night}). Krell watches Sal's warehouse.
4 Krell raids the fence's warehouse: he destroys Sal's protector @UUID[Actor.Q2t6M2IxrRHCJCnC]{Corwin}, kills Sal, and, if she's still unprotected, kills Jun, who had come to collect (@UUID[JournalEntry.FttkHsYSSaCpIugu.JournalEntryPage.j4TnqYOwVuSCeQ0z]{A2-E02 · “Locate. Evaluate. Execute.”}).
5 A terrified Lonnie sets up a meeting at 11:00 p.m. with nrthln_research to sell USB 3 (@UUID[JournalEntry.FttkHsYSSaCpIugu.JournalEntryPage.5Vgl8slqjXlVRbie]{A2-E06 · The One Who Kept One}). If he pulls it off: . ARCHER's second drop (). @UUID[JournalEntry.bJA2iRyDgbm2TcuK]{Okafor} contacts Helen.
6 Krell finds Lonnie, if FIRSTLIGHT doesn't already have him. Krell goes after one of the coterie's Touchstones (@UUID[JournalEntry.C7cxKf7kcAELzuJ1.JournalEntryPage.7brn5AgmWggUl420]{A3-E01 · The Other Son}). The original moves to Halloway's vault.
7 and 8 No changes.

• MEN-01 · Lonnie Barras, the thief who kept one
  • MEN-04 · Dawson, Gale's ghoul head of security (the one who sniffed out the stairwell)
  • MEN-13 · Sal Medeiros, SoDo fence
  • MEN-14 · Corwin, Sal's Caitiff protector
  • P-13 · Sal's ledger: “L.B. — 3 keys, 2 sold, 1 outstanding”
  • P-14 · The payment to Lonnie, made from Cascade Holdings LLC, a Halloway Meridian company (the one Celeste signed for in her prelude)
  • A2-E06 · New scene: “The One Who Kept One”

Editor's Note · MEN-01, MEN-03, MEN-04, and MEN-05

The newest record wins, the one in chapter 8 (doc 14): @UUID[Actor.9rv5Jdb3y6bZZ1fj]{Lonnie Barras} is Lonnie Barras, the thief who kept one (not the whole crew of thieves); @UUID[Actor.L1oU4dlqHg8Yszon]{Montgomery's Bounty Hunters} is Montgomery's Bounty Hunters, with Dutch Lindqvist as a member with his own pools; @UUID[Actor.BzNGxOAK3F6Uo56T]{Halloway's Security Ghouls} is “Dawson and the Security Ghouls” (Dawson, the boss, with his own pools); @UUID[Actor.k2TLqQkkzzjSLzkp]{Salt's Anarchs} is Salt's Anarchs, with Bas Okonjo and Tavi Mercer as members with their own pools.
